summary.motive: Put the frontside defensive end in an impossible spatial dilemma: if he widens to stop the perimeter sweep, the dual-threat QB powers downhill behind a pulling guard.
summary.whyItWorks: The threat of the speed sweep forces the edge defender and nickel DB to play with wide leverage, eliminating the defense's force support and creating a massive downhill power gap.
summary.failureMode: A defensive tackle who defeats the down block inside or a disciplined DE who shuffles and plays both the keep and the pitch.

beats.title: Spread 11-Personnel Power Read Look
beats.text: Steichen spaces the defense across the width of the field in 11-personnel Gun Spread, isolating the frontside defensive end as the unblocked read defender.

beats.title: The Jet Sweep Mesh & DE Conflict
beats.text: RB crosses on a full-speed horizontal sweep track. Frontside SDE widens laterally to prevent the perimeter sweep, immediately opening the interior gap cavity.

beats.title: The QB Keep & Pulling Guard Escort
beats.text: QB reads the widening DE, firmly pulls the ball from the mesh, and explodes downhill into the B-gap behind pulling guard RG.

beats.title: RG Decimates Mike LB in the Hole
beats.text: RG violently pancakes the Mike linebacker at the line of scrimmage, allowing the QB to burst untouched into the secondary for a 15-yard gain.

relations.tell: Backside RG pulls playside while RB crosses on horizontal sweep path; QB reads frontside DE.
